entities.summary: Cheb–Hranice v Čechách railway is the number 148 railway of the Czech Republic, which is partially electrified at 25 kV 50 Hz AC. It is operated by Czech Railways and mainly Czech-made ČD Class 814 and ČD Class 810 locomotives are on the line.
